description.zh: 阿里云 OSS 存储中，用户上传的规则库文件对应的 FileKey（注意：FileKey 生成方式见 [通用接口-文件上传下载GenerateUploadConfig - 生成上传配置](https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/AiMiaoBi/2023-08-01/GenerateUploadConfig?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.18fc281fOiiBil)）。规则库文件只允许使用 docx, xlsx, pdf 格式，其中 xlsx 格式限制两列，且表头必须为“审校依据”和“依据出处”。上传 xlsx 格式能有更好的解析效果，但 docx 和 pdf 也会由系统自动解析。
description.en: The FileKey of your rule library file stored in Alibaba Cloud OSS. For how to generate a FileKey, see [Common APIs: GenerateUploadConfig for File Upload and Download](https://next.api.aliyun.com/document/AiMiaoBi/2023-08-01/GenerateUploadConfig?spm=openapi-amp.newDocPublishment.0.0.18fc281fOiiBil). Your rule library file must be in DOCX, XLSX, or PDF format. If you use XLSX, it must have exactly two columns. The table header must be "Proofreading Basis" and "Source". XLSX files give the best parsing results. DOCX and PDF files are also parsed automatically.

description.zh: 规则库ID（不填默认是 Default ）
description.en: ID of the rule library. If you omit this parameter, the system uses Default.

description.zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取[业务空间ID（Workspace ID）](~~2782167~~)
description.en: Unique identifier of your Model Studio workspace. To get this ID, see [Get the Workspace ID](~~2782167~~).
